 10,000 Lazio fans ‘to make’ trip to Mapei Stadium on Tuesday 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Lazio ’s travelling support could outnumber the hosts at Mapei Stadium on Tuesday.
 Il Corriere dello Sport reports that around 10,000 will make the trip to Sassuolo to back Gennaro Gattuso ’s side.
 OneFootball Videos
 Organised fan groups have been boycotting home matches at the Stadio Olimpico since January, part of an ongoing protest against president Claudio Lotito. The aim is to cut matchday income and increase pressure on him to sell.
 Last week sporting director Angelo Fabiani urged supporters to reconsider, with the team flying in Serie A, winning seven and drawing one from the first eight league fixtures. The groups quickly rejected the appeal, insisting their dispute with Lotito goes beyond results.
 While a small section continues to attend at home, large numbers have travelled this season, including Bologna, Udine, Venice and Turin against Juventus.
 Mapei Stadium’s capacity is roughly 21,000, with 4,000 seats set aside for away fans. That ground has been dominated by travelling support before, notably AC Milan followers who filled the stands as Stefano Pioli’s side clinched the 2021/22 Scudetto.
